title: Extend the existing FA3 AI image-editing projection to Krita without adding capability or authority
decisions: Reuse FA3-AI-IMAGE-EDITING-001 as the shared GIMP and Krita image-editing subprofile; do not create a second image-editing capability.
Treat GIMP and Krita as peer desktop frontends over replaceable governed AI backends.
Accept Acly/krita-ai-diffusion as a strong optional reference provider for Krita to ComfyUI generative interoperability; prefer an external FA3-governed ComfyUI runtime in governed mode.
Accept Acly/krita-vision-tools as an optional local vision-assist provider; all model assets remain subject to canonical model admission and security governance.
Accept Krita MCP adapters only beneath FA3-AUTH-MCP-GATEWAY-001 with authenticated loopback transport, typed operations and GUI-thread-safe mutation semantics.
No Krita plugin or adapter becomes workflow, model registry/router, MCP gateway, host resource, policy, secrets, provenance, evidence or generation-context authority.
GPU selection remains capability-discovered; replacement of the accelerator must not require Krita-specific canonical reconfiguration.
Reference/design PASS proves canonical conformance only; no current-host production runtime claim is made.
